b092e69e4c.why: The two stores use an unknown stride, and both the pointer update and flag-setting counter update must remain.

c22b395608.why: The required vector outputs keep every computation live, and the rounded average and wrapping word additions cannot be fused for arbitrary inputs.

2c0eac7904.why: Both distinct memory blends feed the rounded average and wrapping sum, leaving no removable instruction at AVX2.

26153f327f.why: The two different shuffles feed separate terms, and the rounded average, wrapping additions, and final shift must remain distinct.

3663277d59.why: Both scalar broadcasts are needed to preserve ymm4 while forming ymm3, and the endpoint load and scalar updates are also live.

b429dd1058.why: The unknown stride requires separate stores, while the preserved pointer, counter, and comparison flags require both scalar updates.

f60eea0189.why: The offset calculation, coefficient broadcast, constant mask broadcast, endpoint load, and scalar updates all produce required values.

39f58b297e.why: Both derived masks must be preserved along with the coefficient and position vectors, leaving no dead operation.

cbd36d204f.why: Four 256-bit stores are needed for the 128 output bytes under AVX2, and the pointer and flag-setting counter updates are required.

5d3c035825.why: The comparison depends on the upper bits computed by lea as well as the replaced low byte, and r11 must also be zeroed.
